Name: Svip
Description: Asgardian Berserkers Svip, and his associates Bodvar and Einhar persist in a strange foreign land to kill undesirables. They are Berserkers. Exiled by Odin in some time in the distant past, they spend their lives killing and fighting against giant creatures and surreal monsters. However one day they would find a new Berserker amongst their midst, the warrior Sif who had been transported their by her brother Heimdall.
